data.title: Digital Transformation
data.tagline: A practical route from fragmented systems to a connected operation.
data.overview: Transformation fails when it starts with technology. We help leadership sequence change around a clear operating problem, then deliver the data, systems, and habits that make the change durable.

problems.title: Pilot purgatory
problems.description: Many proofs of concept, no production deployment, and a tired organisation.

problems.title: Unclear ownership
problems.description: OT and IT both care, but no one owns the operating outcome.

problems.title: Data silos
problems.description: Every function has a number, and none of them agree.

approach.title: Diagnostic
approach.description: A short, evidence-led review of operations, systems, and decision latency.

approach.title: Sequenced roadmap
approach.description: Value cases, dependencies, and a realistic delivery order.

approach.title: Delivery with operators
approach.description: Joint teams, short increments, and adoption built into the plan.

approach.title: Governance that lasts
approach.description: Decision rights, standards, and a model for continuous improvement.

capabilities.title: Digital strategy
capabilities.description: A roadmap tied to margin, risk, and capacity — not a technology catalogue.

capabilities.title: Architecture
capabilities.description: Reference architecture for data, integration, and identity.

capabilities.title: Change and adoption
capabilities.description: Role-based training, comms, and operating routines.

capabilities.title: Analytics
capabilities.description: Decision-grade reporting with clear definitions and lineage.

benefits.title: Fewer stalled pilots
benefits.description: Each initiative has an owner, a metric, and a route to scale.

benefits.title: Faster decisions
benefits.description: Data arrives where the decision is made.

benefits.title: Lower technology risk
benefits.description: Architecture and standards that survive vendor change.

benefits.title: A capable organisation
benefits.description: Internal teams able to run and extend the platform.
